summary: Iteration 46 - Stock Management & Hotel Accounting Modules Testing COMPLETE. All 29 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all panels, tabs, and buttons working correctly. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in variance check endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/stock/variance/{property_id} - added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one
Stock Management module has 5 tabs: Products, Recipes, Movements, Cost Analysis, Variances
Accounting module has 4 tabs: P&L Overview, Income, Expenses, Budget vs Actual
All CRUD operations for products, recipes, movements, income, expenses, budgets working correctly
Stock movements auto-update product current_stock based on movement_type
Recipes auto-calculate total_cost and margin_pct from ingredient products
Outlets auto-seed 4 default outlets (Main Restaurant, Lobby Bar, Pool Café, Kitchen Store) on first call
P&L auto-pulls room_revenue from bookings collection when no manual entries exist
All-inclusive cost calculation combines F&B costs with guest nights from bookings
Variance check compares expected vs actual stock to detect theft/waste
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for products, recipes, movements, income, expenses, budgets - all cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 added two new modules: Stock Management and Hotel Accounting. Stock Management handles F&B inventory with products, recipes, movements, cost analysis, and variance detection. Accounting handles income, expenses, P&L statements, and budget vs actual comparisons. The sidebar shows these under 'OPERATIONS' section as 'Stock / F&B' and 'Accounting'. Use property_id 'city-gate' for testing. Stock may show 0 initially on 'All Branches' - select a specific branch.

endpoints_tested.notes: Create recipe with ingredients, auto-calculates cost/margin
Run variance check - FIXED ObjectId bug
Cost per guest per night calculation

frontend_tests.sidebar_section: OPERATIONS section visible with Stock / F&B and Accounting links

bug_fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId not JSON serializable - ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable")]
bug_fixed.fix: Added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one in /app/backend/routes/stock.py line 223
bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one adds _id field to the document which contains ObjectId type that FastAPI cannot serialize to JSON
